title: Hexaware Technologies shares jump 12% after Anthropic deal, extends winning streak
source_used: Business Standard (the ET Now page returned an error page)
key_facts: Hexaware Technologies shares rose 12% in early trade on Friday 9 October after it announced a multi-year partnership with Anthropic.
Under it, Hexaware becomes a Preferred Partner in Anthropic's Claude Partner Network, according to an exchange filing.
Claude goes into two Hexaware platforms: Zerovity (AI-native engineering) and AgentVerse (agent build and governance, with 600+ pre-built agents).
Hexaware has more than 1,100 Claude-certified professionals, the filing said.
It was the stock's fifth consecutive winning session, up 17% over the period.
The alliance builds on Hexaware's existing authorization to resell Claude through Amazon Bedrock.
Coverage dated 8 Oct (PR Newswire, TradingView, CNBC TV18) shows the partnership was announced a day earlier.
